verdict.rationale: Insomnia supports batch-style execution through its Collection Runner, which sends multiple requests in a set order and tests many requests in a collection at once. Environments apply shared variables across many requests, and the Inso CLI automates these runs in CI. This is bulk execution rather than general bulk operations on items, and nothing in the evidence shows multi-select editing, moving or deleting items, or bulk actions driven by AI or scripts. Missing for 10: bulk edit/delete/move of requests or collections, bulk operations exposed via API/CLI/AI, independent or hands-on corroboration.
